results.name: Office, participant follow-up and website maintenance have distinct responsibility and destinations
Time deadlines use Sydney midnight while document dates retain calendar-day meaning
Person reminders stay blue; missing due dates do not invent urgency
Specific actions lead to messages, payroll, recruitment, support and incidents
The queue filters responsibility before pagination, sorts urgency and searches displayed subject
Task rows expose next step and status without requiring details to be opened
Participant follow-ups have no office assignment form or admin implication
Website tasks show the website rather than the admin name; all supplied content is escaped
Empty office view keeps the other counts visible and makes no claim that their work is complete
Pagination retains the active responsibility view
Personal first-visit feedback is explicitly optional rather than a missing requirement
Text on all task status colours meets 4.5:1 contrast
Missing hostname requests hosting setup; no handshake is attempted for a local or unsafe origin
A healthy certificate clears the alert and cached checks do not repeat before their next due time
Certificate expiry produces a dated renewal task and renewal clears it automatically
Transient failures retry automatically; repeated failures become one clear technical alert
Certificate trust failures alert immediately and successful recovery clears them
A stopped scheduler cannot leave a healthy badge indefinitely
Probe rejects private DNS answers and validates hostname with TLS trust enabled
DNS and TLS stalls time out; a late DNS result cannot open a connection
